description: Flat per-sample metadata schema for 18S rRNA amplicon sequencing of eukaryotic microbial communities in freshwater lakes, including lake context, spatial position, seasonal timing, and key environmental measurements.

sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual sample record.

lake_id.descr: Unique identifier or name for the lake where the sample was collected.

lake_name.descr: Common name of the lake, if different from the unique identifier.

geographic_region.descr: Broader geographic region of the lake or study site (e.g., country, state/province, basin, or eco-region).

site_id.descr: Identifier for the specific sampling site within the lake.

sampling_zone.descr: Lake zone or habitat category where the sample was taken (e.g., littoral, pelagic, benthic, inlet, outlet).

sampling_depth_m.descr: Sampling depth below water surface in meters (m).

depth_interval_m.descr: Depth range represented by the sample, if integrated over a vertical interval, in meters (m).

latitude.descr: Sampling location latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

longitude.descr: Sampling location longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84).

sampling_date.descr: Date of sample collection in ISO 8601 format (YYYY-MM-DD).

season.descr: Season at time of sampling (e.g., spring, summer, autumn/fall, winter).

water_temperature_c.descr: In situ water temperature in degrees Celsius (°C).

dissolved_oxygen_mg_l.descr: Dissolved oxygen concentration in milligrams per liter (mg/L).

dissolved_oxygen_percent_sat.descr: Dissolved oxygen as percent saturation (%), if measured.

ph.descr: Water pH measured at the sampling location.

conductivity_uS_cm.descr: Electrical conductivity of water in microsiemens per centimeter (µS/cm), if measured.

turbidity_ntu.descr: Water turbidity in nephelometric turbidity units (NTU), if measured.

chlorophyll_a_ug_l.descr: Chlorophyll-a concentration in micrograms per liter (µg/L), if measured.

nitrate_nitrite_mg_l.descr: Combined nitrate plus nitrite concentration in milligrams per liter as N (mg/L N), if measured.

ammonium_mg_l.descr: Ammonium concentration in milligrams per liter as N (mg/L N), if measured.

phosphate_mg_l.descr: Orthophosphate concentration in milligrams per liter as P (mg/L P), if measured.

total_nitrogen_mg_l.descr: Total nitrogen concentration in milligrams per liter as N (mg/L N), if measured.

total_phosphorus_mg_l.descr: Total phosphorus concentration in milligrams per liter as P (mg/L P), if measured.

water_column_stratified.descr: Whether the lake was stratified at the time of sampling.

sampling_method.descr: Method used to collect the water sample (e.g., Niskin bottle, pump, integrated tube, grab sample).

filter_pore_size_um.descr: Filter pore size used to capture microbial biomass, in micrometers (µm), if applicable.

filtered_volume_l.descr: Volume of water filtered for DNA extraction, in liters (L).

dna_extraction_method.descr: Protocol or kit used for DNA extraction from the sample.

marker_gene.descr: Target marker gene sequenced for community profiling; for this dataset, expected value is 18S rRNA gene.

amplicon_region.descr: Amplified region of the marker gene (e.g., V4, V9, or other 18S region).

primer_forward.descr: Forward primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

primer_reverse.descr: Reverse primer sequence or primer name used for amplification.

sequencing_platform.descr: Sequencing instrument/platform used (e.g., Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq).

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation or PCR protocol used for the amplicon sequencing library.

replicate_id.descr: Technical or biological replicate identifier, if the sample is part of a replicated design.

seasonal_sampling_campaign.descr: Identifier for the seasonal sampling campaign or timepoint grouping.

notes.descr: Free-text notes relevant to the sample, including anomalies, weather conditions, or deviations from protocol.
